clusters.title: New ping_worker behavior has no regression coverage

member_findings.title: New ping_worker behavior has no regression coverage
member_findings.impact: The new helper adds input validation for host/count and maps the system ping return code to a boolean, but the PR adds no unit test that would fail if validation is removed, invalid arguments are accepted, or ping failures are reported as success.
member_findings.fix: Add a focused test for ping_worker that mocks subprocess.run and covers a successful ping, a non-zero return code, empty or dash-prefixed host rejection, and non-positive count rejection.

fun plan() {
  val registry = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val context = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val issues = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/issues.json")
  val pr = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.json")
  val diff = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
  val selected = compute("Filter issues to exact PR token from context and select context.inputs.issue.number", context, issues)
  val lineContext = compute("Use PR metadata and diff only to confirm the referenced path and line still exist", selected, pr, diff)
  val evidence = compute("Build one-cluster evidence JSON with agent_security", registry, context, selected, lineContext)
  writeFile("/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", evidence)
  publish("safeoutputs.noop", "No GitHub action needed: wrote single-cluster triage evidence for pinned ai-review issue 237.")
}
